observations: Rework F-003 (2026-10-05, narrow re-check for context-quality-reviewer finding): re-read the full source doc line-by-line specifically looking for API endpoint, request/response shape, or data model/schema content for feature wholesale-pricing-offer. Found only one config object (`customConfig = { ENABLE_WHOLESALE_QTY_ENFORCE_OPTION: true }`, already extracted as CLM-05-066, claim_kind config_default — a runtime feature flag, not an API contract or a data model/schema) and a vague mention of 'the app's own line-item properties' (already covered by CLM-05-071, claim_kind enum_or_boundary) with no field names/shape given — neither qualifies as api_contract or data_model. Declared the gap as a new not_documented[] entry instead of leaving it silent. No new claims added, no existing claim changed.
unknowns: DOC-05 không tự khai version/generated_at riêng trong nội dung; dùng doc_set batch value (v1 / 2026-10-01) theo input/doc-manifest.json. Nhiều claim trong file lại có ngày live-verify riêng trong văn bản (2026-09-07/08/09) khác với doc_set_generated_at — cả hai được giữ nguyên trong statement/quote, không hoà giải, để normalizer tự chọn authored_on phù hợp.
